# x402 Schema Gate

Primary endpoint: POST https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/v1/schema-gate
Purpose: deterministic JSON canonicalization plus a bounded JSON Schema and buyer-committed acceptance evaluation
Required request keys: order_id, idempotency_key, input, target_schema, acceptance_criteria, acceptance_commitment
Optional request key: expires_at
Idempotency key: 8-128 characters
Acceptance criteria: exactly canonical_json=true, required_fields, forbidden_patterns, max_output_bytes, normalizer_version=schema-gate-c14n-v1
Commitment: sha256:<lowercase SHA-256 hex of sorted compact JSON acceptance_criteria>
Verdict: ACCEPT or REJECT; output exists only for ACCEPT
Price: exactly 0.010 USDC (10000 atomic units) per completed signed evaluation
Billing: both ACCEPT and REJECT are paid; malformed preflight, payment, and provider failures are unsettled
Recovery: exact idempotent retry or GET /v1/orders/{order_id} with a server-issued recovery token, no second charge
Receipt: ES256 envelope verified with https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/.well-known/receipt-key.json
Usage: each new task is a new paid execution; SDK integration itself is free
Protocol: x402 v2 exact on solana:5eykt4UsFv8P8NJdTREpY1vzqKqZKvdp
Asset: EPjFWdd5AufqSSqeM2qN1xzybapC8G4wEGGkZwyTDt1v
Recipient: E2PxHWFSwzt6a3osZRQeT16tsb7BPLfXEMuDfjnZuhFD

Send an unpaid request to receive PAYMENT-REQUIRED. Submit the canonical base64 x402 v2 PaymentPayload in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. A wallet address or raw transaction hash is not proof. A completed call returns PAYMENT-RESPONSE plus a signed receipt.

Discovery: https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/.well-known/x402.json
OpenAPI: https://www.x402digitalvendingmachine.store/openapi.json
SDK: https://github.com/woodhouseog/x402-digital-vending-machine

The repository contains a portable descriptor only. No PyPI publication, MCP registry acceptance, external demand, or revenue is claimed.
